Hetzner 2026 price changes: keep, rescale or move?

Answer: Hetzner raised cloud prices twice in 2026: on Apr 1, 2026 for every server (EU CPX22 €5.99 → €7.99/mo excl. VAT and IPv4) and on Jun 15, 2026 for new orders and any rescale only (CPX22 €19.49, 2.4× the pre-June price; US CPX11 €5.99 → €17.49). So keep a pre-June server untouched, because even scaling it down switches it to the new list (CPX32 → CPX22 costs €5.50/mo more), and if you need a different size, move: as of 2026-10-31, OVHcloud VPS-1 costs $5.35/mo all-in vs $26.84 for a new Hetzner CPX22 (EU) (2 TB egress, backups on).

Checked 2026-10-31 on Hetzner's own pages and docs. Prices excl. VAT. All-in = list price + IPv4 + backups + traffic overage at 2 TB/month; EUR at 1.1188 USD (ECB, 2026-10-26). For Hetzner's full current plan list see Hetzner VPS pricing; for every alternative ranked, Hetzner alternatives.

Key numbers
  • EU CPX22 (2 vCPU / 4 GB): €5.99 → €7.99 (Apr 1, everyone) → €19.49 (Jun 15, new orders + rescales), excl. VAT and IPv4
  • US CPX11 (2 vCPU / 2 GB): €4.49 → €5.99 → €17.49 (2.9× in June)
  • Scaling down still costs more: pre-June CPX32 → CPX22 = +€5.50/mo
  • New CPX22 ranks #8 of 12 orderable 2 vCPU / 4 GB plans; cheapest is OVHcloud VPS-1 at $5.35/mo all-in
  • Cost-Optimized CX23/CX33: sold out on Hetzner's page (checked 2026-10-31), so the cheap Hetzner option isn't orderable

What a rescale costs

Hetzner's billing FAQ: these actions move a pre-June server to current prices: “Rescaling (regardless of whether the server is scaled up or down)”, “Restoring a deleted server”, “Transferring a server to another project with a different currency”. These don't: “Rebuilding a server”, “Transferring a server to another project with the same currency” (source · checked 2026-10-31).

What people are saying, and our answers

  • It's so bad I will be looking at moving off Hetzner at this point. 3x is too much. (urda, Hacker News, thread)
  • You continue to pay the old price as long as you don't change your plan! (chadgpt3, Hacker News, thread)
  • Their USA cloud prices went from affordable to AWS and then some (unsafetypin, LowEndTalk, thread)
  • Is it better or worse than OVH right now? (concept, LowEndTalk, thread)
  • Are there no more cost-optimized servers available? (r/hetzner, thread)
Do I have to migrate?

No. Hetzner: “Existing server contracts will keep their terms and conditions and remain active.” A server ordered before Jun 15, 2026 keeps its price (EU CPX22 €8.49/mo incl. IPv4) until you rescale it, restore it after deleting it, or move it to a project in another currency. Rebuilding it or moving it to a same-currency project does not change the price.

Is Hetzner still the cheapest?

Not for new servers. For 2 vCPU / 4 GB at 2 TB egress with backups, a new CPX22 (EU) is $26.84/mo all-in and ranks #8 of 12 orderable plans we track; the cheapest is OVHcloud VPS-1 at $5.35. A pre-June CPX22 you keep is $11.40/mo on the same basis; 2 orderable plans are cheaper even than that (OVHcloud VPS-1 $5.35, OVHcloud VPS-2 $10.00), so weigh the saving against the work of migrating.

Can I scale down to save money?

No. Hetzner's billing FAQ lists “Rescaling (regardless of whether the server is scaled up or down)” as an action that moves a server to current pricing. Scaling a pre-June CPX32 (€14.49) down to CPX22 bills €19.99/mo, €5.50 more each month.

What does a rescale cost me?

EU CPX22 → CPX32: €8.49 → €35.99/mo (+€27.50, €990.00 over 36 months). US CPX11 → CPX21: €6.49 → €32.49/mo (+€26.00). Prices excl. VAT, incl. the €0.50 IPv4.

Is Hetzner US still worth it?

A new US CPX21 (3 vCPU / 4 GB) is $43.62/mo all-in at 2 TB; AWS Lightsail 4 GB is $24.00 and OVHcloud VPS-1 $5.35 on the same basis. US Hetzner plans include 1–2 TB of traffic, not 20 TB.

Is it better or worse than OVH right now?

For a new 2 vCPU / 4 GB server, yes, OVHcloud VPS-1 is cheaper: $5.35/mo vs $26.84 for Hetzner CPX22 (EU) (2 TB, backups on). A grandfathered CPX22 ($11.40) is still $6.05/mo more than OVH VPS-1, a $217.74 gap over 36 months.

What about netcup, Leaseweb or Contabo?

Not verified in our ledger yet (Contabo is listed as unverified). We only rank prices we read on the vendor's own page; check theirs before you move.

How to decide
  • Pre-June server that still fits? Keep it and don't rescale: you keep €8.49/mo for a CPX22.
  • Need more (or less) CPU/RAM? Price the rescale above against a move; at 2 vCPU / 4 GB OVHcloud VPS-1 is $5.35/mo all-in.
  • New project? Hetzner's cheap CX plans are sold out; a new CPX22 is $26.84/mo all-in. Compare in the calculator or Hetzner vs DigitalOcean.
